learning.learning_goal: Count groups from 11 through 15, one dot at a time.
learning.big_idea: The last number counted tells how many dots are in the group.
novice_success_criteria: connect 11 through 15 with spoken names and groups of dots
count each dot once in a different arrangement

screens.label: Start here
screens.title: Meet 11 through 15.
screens.body: Start with ten dots. Count the extra dots.
screens.audio: We will count from eleven to fifteen.

screens.label: Number 11
screens.title: 11 — eleven
screens.audio: This is eleven. Tap the dots to hear them in order.

visual.ariaLabel: 11 blue dots. First ten, then 1 more.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count every dot once. Choose the number.

visual.ariaLabel: 11 blue dots. First ten, then 1 more.

choices.feedback: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
